stories.title: Valkyries make history, oust Aces to reach Finals in 2nd year as franchise
stories.summary: The second-year Valkyries became the quickest expansion team to reach the WNBA Finals, sweeping the defending champion Aces 87-77 in overtime in Game 3.

stories.title: Reese says 'job is not done' as Dream sweep Liberty to reach WNBA Finals
stories.summary: Angel Reese had 22 points as the Dream finished the Liberty with an 85-83 win in Game 3 to advance to the WNBA Finals for the first time since 2013.

stories.title: Norvell shoulders blame as FSU authors another 'extremely poor performance'
stories.summary: After Florida State rushed to a 14-0 advantage, Louisville rallied to take down the struggling Seminoles 44-20, increasing the pressure on embattled coach Mike Norvell, who told reporters that it was "an extremely poor performance by us."

stories.title: Ronaldo suspended by Portugal FA after walkout, dispute with coach
stories.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo has been provisionally suspended by the Portuguese Football Federation (FPF) following his decision to walk out of the national team camp after a dispute with head coach Jorge Jesus.

stories.title: Kyle Busch's 11-year-old son highlights celebration of life ceremony with burnout
stories.summary: The NASCAR community and more than 10,000 race fans celebrated the life of the late Kyle Busch during an uplifting ceremony at Charlotte Motor Speedway.
